links.comparator_used: Alternative percentile cutoffs for the alert threshold (95th vs 75th percentile), compared on clinical workload
links.outcome: Clinical workload implications of the risk-score cutoff when the model is operationalized
links.effect: The 95th percentile cutoff did not substantially increase clinical workloads, while the 75th percentile cutoff substantially impacted workloads. No numeric workload figures are given in the abstract.
links.tradeoff: A lower cutoff (75th percentile) substantially increased workload. The authors suggest a stepped-care framework may mitigate this burden.
links.quote: When operationalized, the 95  th percentile cutoff did not substantially increase clinical workloads, while the 75  th percentile cutoff substantially impacted workloads.

design_hint: alert threshold selection (risk percentile cutoffs) with workload analysis
